schema.text: How does shade and heat (e.g., from sun exposure or hot pavement) affect your walking journeys during warmer months?

options.text: Heat and sun have no effect on my walking journeys
I feel uncomfortable in the heat but I continue as planned
I adjust my departure time or choose shadier routes when possible
I significantly shorten or avoid walking trips during hot weather
I stop walking outdoors entirely during the hottest periods

en.#How does shade and heat (e.g., from sun: How does shade and heat (e.g., from sun exposure or hot pavement) affect your walking journeys during warmer months?

en.#I significantly shorten or avoid walkin: I significantly shorten or avoid walking trips during hot weather

it.#How does shade and heat (e.g., from sun: In che modo l'ombra e il caldo (ad es. dovuti all'esposizione al sole o alla pavimentazione calda) influenzano i tuoi spostamenti a piedi nei mesi più caldi?
it.#Heat and sun have no effect on my walki: Il caldo e il sole non influiscono sui miei spostamenti a piedi
it.#I feel uncomfortable in the heat but I: Mi sento a disagio con il caldo, ma continuo come previsto
it.#I adjust my departure time or choose sh: Modifico l'orario di partenza o scelgo percorsi più ombreggiati quando possibile
it.#I significantly shorten or avoid walkin: Accorcio significativamente o evito gli spostamenti a piedi quando fa caldo
it.#I stop walking outdoors entirely during: Smetto completamente di camminare all'aperto durante i periodi più caldi

fr.#How does shade and heat (e.g., from sun: Pendant les mois chauds, comment l’ombre et la chaleur, par exemple le soleil ou un sol très chaud, influencent-elles vos trajets à pied ?
fr.#Heat and sun have no effect on my walki: La chaleur et le soleil n’ont aucun effet sur mes trajets à pied
fr.#I feel uncomfortable in the heat but I: La chaleur me gêne, mais je continue comme prévu
fr.#I adjust my departure time or choose sh: Je change mon heure de départ ou je choisis des itinéraires plus ombragés quand c’est possible
fr.#I significantly shorten or avoid walkin: Je réduis fortement ou j’évite les trajets à pied quand il fait très chaud
fr.#I stop walking outdoors entirely during: Je ne marche plus du tout dehors pendant les périodes les plus chaudes

de.#How does shade and heat (e.g., from sun: Wie beeinflussen Schatten und Hitze, zum Beispiel direkte Sonne oder heißer Straßenbelag, Ihre Wege zu Fuß in den wärmeren Monaten?
de.#Heat and sun have no effect on my walki: Hitze und Sonne beeinflussen meine Wege zu Fuß nicht
de.#I feel uncomfortable in the heat but I: Die Hitze ist unangenehm, aber ich gehe wie geplant weiter
de.#I adjust my departure time or choose sh: Ich ändere meine Abfahrtszeit oder wähle schattigere Wege, wenn es möglich ist
de.#I significantly shorten or avoid walkin: Bei heißem Wetter verkürze oder vermeide ich Wege zu Fuß deutlich
de.#I stop walking outdoors entirely during: In den heißesten Zeiten gehe ich draußen gar nicht zu Fuß

tr.#How does shade and heat (e.g., from sun: Sıcak aylarda gölge ve sıcaklık, örneğin güneş veya sıcak zemin, yürüyüşlerinizi nasıl etkiler?
tr.#I feel uncomfortable in the heat but I: Sıcakta rahatsız olurum ama planladığım şekilde devam ederim
tr.#I adjust my departure time or choose sh: Mümkünse çıkış saatimi değiştirir veya daha gölgeli güzergâhlar seçerim
tr.#I significantly shorten or avoid walkin: Sıcak havalarda yürüyüşlerimi belirgin şekilde kısaltır veya yürümekten kaçınırım
tr.#I stop walking outdoors entirely during: En sıcak zamanlarda dışarıda yürümeyi tamamen bırakırım

fa.#How does shade and heat (e.g., from sun: در ماه‌های گرم، سایه و گرما، مثلاً آفتاب مستقیم یا سطح داغ خیابان، چگونه بر سفرهای پیاده شما اثر می‌گذارد؟
fa.#Heat and sun have no effect on my walki: گرما و آفتاب بر سفرهای پیاده من اثری ندارد
fa.#I feel uncomfortable in the heat but I: در گرما ناراحت می‌شوم، اما طبق برنامه ادامه می‌دهم
fa.#I adjust my departure time or choose sh: اگر ممکن باشد زمان حرکت را تغییر می‌دهم یا مسیر سایه‌دارتر انتخاب می‌کنم
fa.#I significantly shorten or avoid walkin: در هوای گرم سفرهای پیاده را خیلی کوتاه می‌کنم یا از آن‌ها پرهیز می‌کنم
fa.#I stop walking outdoors entirely during: در گرم‌ترین زمان‌ها اصلاً بیرون پیاده‌روی نمی‌کنم

hu.#How does shade and heat (e.g., from sun: A melegebb hónapokban hogyan befolyásolja az árnyék és a hőség, például a közvetlen napsütés vagy a forró burkolat a gyalogos útjait?
hu.#Heat and sun have no effect on my walki: A hőség és a napsütés nem befolyásolja a gyalogos útjaimat
hu.#I feel uncomfortable in the heat but I: Kellemetlenül érzem magam a hőségben, de a tervek szerint folytatom az utat
hu.#I adjust my departure time or choose sh: Ha lehet, módosítom az indulási időt vagy árnyékosabb útvonalat választok
hu.#I significantly shorten or avoid walkin: Meleg időben jelentősen lerövidítem vagy elkerülöm a gyalogos utakat
hu.#I stop walking outdoors entirely during: A legmelegebb időszakokban egyáltalán nem gyalogolok a szabadban

ar.#How does shade and heat (e.g., from sun: في الأشهر الحارة، كيف يؤثر الظل والحر، مثل التعرض للشمس أو سخونة الرصيف، في رحلاتك سيرًا على الأقدام؟
ar.#Heat and sun have no effect on my walki: الحر والشمس لا يؤثران في رحلاتي سيرًا على الأقدام
ar.#I feel uncomfortable in the heat but I: أشعر بعدم الراحة في الحر لكنني أواصل كما خططت
ar.#I adjust my departure time or choose sh: أغيّر وقت الانطلاق أو أختار طرقًا أكثر ظلًا عندما يكون ذلك ممكنًا
ar.#I significantly shorten or avoid walkin: أقلل كثيرًا من رحلات المشي أو أتجنبها في الطقس الحار
ar.#I stop walking outdoors entirely during: أتوقف تمامًا عن المشي في الخارج خلال أشد فترات الحر
